component.name: Oma Audiobooks
component.summary: Listen to local audiobooks and keep your place

description.p: A native audiobook library and player for Linux, built with Qt Quick. Add your own DRM-free MP3 book folders or M4B files, browse by series, and continue listening where you left off.

ul.li: Saved listening progress, bookmarks, favorites and completion status
Series grouping, search, library filters and editable book details
Chapter navigation and timeline previews, playback speed and sleep timer
Keyboard shortcuts and desktop media controls
Omarchy theme integration and built-in dark and light appearances

description.p: No account, server, telemetry or network connection is required. Audio files remain unchanged. Books are not included; this app does not download Audible books or remove DRM.

screenshot.caption: Series grouping with a preview library and illustrative progress
Light appearance with series headings hidden

description.p: First Flatpak release with series browsing, chapter timeline previews, bookmarks, keyboard shortcuts and persistent listening progress.
